title: MetaDragon — Unlimited Minting via `transfer()` to Contract Address Analysis
root_cause: In the `transfer(to, tokenId)` function, when `to == address(this) || to == erc721`, `transform(value)` is called, triggering unlimited minting. The attacker iterated token IDs 0–39 to mass-mint MetaTokens and swap them for WBNB
steps: → [3] Large MetaToken balance accumulated over 40 iterations
other_code:
Attacker
  │
  ├─→ [1] for (tokenId = 0; tokenId < 40; tokenId++)
  │
  ├─→ [2] MetaToken.transfer(address(MetaToken), tokenId)
  │         └─ to == address(this) condition satisfied
  │         └─ transform(tokenId) called → MetaToken minted
  │
  ├─→ [3] Large MetaToken balance accumulated over 40 iterations
  │
  ├─→ [4] MetaToken.approve(router, maxAmount)
  │
  ├─→ [5] MetaToken → WBNB swap (Uniswap V2)
  │
  └─→ [6] ~$180K worth of WBNB drained
